_comment: Patch A2 -- MCP Server Registry & Config. Loaded by eo/mcp_registry.py
token below is expanded from a real environment variable at connect
time -- see backend/.env.example's 'MCP Servers' section for what each
one is and where to get it. Never put a real secret directly in this
file; it's checked into version control.
Deliberately Tier 1 only (see the implementation guide's own scope
note on Patch A2): filesystem-equivalent capability is skipped here
on purpose -- the daemon already covers that (docs/decisions/0001).
Do not add a filesystem MCP server to this list. Tier 3/4 servers
launcher) are likewise out of scope until the safety architecture in
Patch A4 has been live and proven for this lower-risk Tier 1 set.
A4's safety gate, not by this patch -- but the classification is a
property of the server config (how much do we trust THIS server's
tools), so it's recorded here now rather than invented later at call
time. 'mutating' is the safe default for any tool not explicitly
listed as read_only -- see eo/mcp_registry.py's classify_tool().
